_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (consolidated, Rs crore). Three segments on the company's own EBITDA definition (includes grant income such as PLI and JLR R&D credits): JLR (revenue built in GBP x INR/GBP in `jlrBuild`), Tata Passenger Vehicles (India PV + EV; volume x realisation in `pvBuild`) and Others (Tata Technologies + unallocated). `unallocated` removes grant income from EBITDA so that model EBITDA is on Screener's basis (grants sit in Screener's other income, and are added back in `otherIncome`). Base year FY26 is distorted (JLR cyber attack; Rs82,616 cr demerger gain in profit), so growth rates off FY26 are not meaningful. Net profit is on the owners' basis (TMPV.patch.js). Valued on a sum of the parts as the street does: JLR and India PV on EV/EBITDA (Sep-28E), Tata Technologies at market, less net debt at Sep-27E and minority claims; multiples written by tools/authoring/TMPV.sotp.js.

segments.name: Jaguar Land Rover
segments._why: Revenue = GBP revenue x INR/GBP (jlrBuild). EBITDA margin (Ind AS segment): 14.3% FY25, 6.7% FY26 (cyber), 8.1% Q1FY27 (EBIT 2.8%). Guidance c.4% EBIT for FY27; we assume 3.5% (Q1 2.8%, China 'may get worse before it stabilises', VME 7.1%), i.e. ~8.8% EBITDA with D&A ~5.3% of revenue. FY28E 11.0% (EBIT ~5.7%): four launches (Range Rover Electric and Sport Electric, Range Rover GT, Jaguar Type 01) and the GBP1.7bn cost programme; FY29E 11.8%. Street: Emkay EBIT 4.0%/5.7% FY27/28E.

segments.name: Tata Passenger Vehicles (India PV + EV)
segments._why: Revenue = wholesales x realisation (pvBuild). EBITDA incl. PLI: 6.9% FY25 and FY26 (5.0% ex PLI in FY26), 4.3% Q1FY27 after a 4.5% commodity hit, Q2 guided flat. FY27E 5.8% (H2 step-up from PLI on new models, price rises, cost cuts), FY28E 7.0%, FY29E 6.0% because PLI (~2.3% of revenue) ends after FY28 and cost cuts only partly replace it. Management: 8% EBITDA by FY29, 10% by FY31; JM Financial FY27E 6.8%.

segments.name: Others (Tata Technologies, unallocated)
segments._why: Tata Technologies' external revenue and unallocated items: FY26 Rs3,814 cr at 13.9%; Q1FY27 Rs1,164 cr at 12.5%. Valued at TTL's market price in the SOTP, not on this EBITDA.

jlrBuild._why: GBP revenue FY27E GBP25.5bn vs guidance ~GBP26bn (Q1 GBP5.97bn, -9.6%; new EVs add little before H2), FY28E +7% (launches), FY29E +5.5%. INR/GBP held at the Q1FY27 segment rate (Rs76,705 cr / GBP5,973m = 128.4; FY26 average 119.3), so ~7.6 points of FY27E INR growth is currency.

pvBuild._why: Wholesales incl. exports: Q1FY27 182.3k (+46%); production ramping to 65-70k a month; H2 laps a high base (Q3-Q4FY26 372k); management 'higher double-digit' growth, ICICI Direct +23%, JM +16.5% -> +20% (~770k). FY28-29E +12%/+11% (management 15% CAGR to FY31). Realisation (revenue per unit) Q1FY27 Rs9.84 lakh, +7.9% vs FY26 average on EV mix (20%+) and Sierra: +6% FY27E, then +3%.

_unallocLabel: Grant income and incentives (in segment EBITDA; Screener shows them in other income)
_unallocWhy: FY26 Rs3,603 cr (JLR Rs2,295 cr, India Rs1,276 cr incl. PLI Rs1,044 cr); Q1FY27 Rs764 cr. FY27E: JLR ~Rs1,800 cr + PLI ~Rs1,650 cr (2.2% of India revenue) + other India grants ~Rs250 cr; FY28E Rs1,900 + 2,000 + 270 cr; FY29E Rs2,000 + 0 + 290 cr (PLI ends after FY28).
_esopWhy: Share-based pay is inside employee costs in the segment EBITDA; not separated (zero here).
_capexWhy: Screener 'fixed assets purchased' Rs36,282 cr in FY26. JLR investment GBP3.7bn in FY27 (guidance) of which ~GBP2.8bn capitalised (engineering capitalisation 64-74%) = ~Rs36K cr; GBP18bn over FY24-FY28 implies ~GBP3.6bn in FY28. India ~7% of revenue (Rs37.5-40K cr over FY27-31, front-loaded) = Rs5.5-6.5K cr.
_depWhy: FY26 depreciation Rs19,784 cr = 6.2% of average gross block (Rs3.17 lakh cr); Q1FY27 Rs4,880 cr. The engine holds CWIP (Rs1.03 lakh cr incl. intangibles under development) flat and depreciates capex at once; 6.1% gives ~Rs20.5K / 23.0K / 25.5K cr, rising as the new JLR platforms are capitalised.
_treasuryWhy: The engine's treasury is net debt (negative), so no yield; interest income is in otherIncome.
_otherIncomeWhy: Screener other income = grants + other income (excl. grants) + share of equity-accounted profit (Q1FY27: 764 + 357 + 24 = 1,145). FY27E: grants 3,700 + interest and other ~1,500 (Q1 357; lower cash than FY26's 2,153) + China JV and associates ~250 - minority share ~300 (Tata Technologies' 46.65%, no minority line in the engine); FY28E 4,170 + 1,600 + 350 - 320; FY29E 2,290 + 1,700 + 450 - 340. FY26 Rs6,411 cr; TTM to Jun-26 Rs6,047 cr.
_interestWhy: FY26 Rs2,827 cr; Q1FY27 Rs835 cr (Rs3,340 cr annualised) after JLR drew GBP1bn+ of new loans; gross debt Rs79K cr incl. leases at Mar-26.
_taxWhy: FY25 continuing operations 31.8%; Q1FY27 45% on a small PBT; UK 25% plus non-deductible items and other jurisdictions; India losses carried forward. 30%.
_payoutWhy: FY26 dividend Rs3 a share (Rs1,105 cr); JLR pays 25% of PAT to the parent. 15-20% of EPS.

dcf._betaWhy: Engine discounts at the cost of equity; beta 0.75 sets the rate at 11.0%, our WACC (Ke ~12.5% on 70% equity, after-tax cost of debt ~6% on 30% net debt-to-capital at market).
dcf._tgWhy: In INR: UK/US nominal growth ~3-4% plus INR depreciation, India PV faster: 5%.
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~5-6% to 6% (India PV keeps growing, JLR mature).
dcf._fadeMarginWhy: Screener-basis EBITDA margin to 10.5% (company basis ~11%): JLR below its FY24-25 peak of 14%, India PV towards 8-10%.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Capex 9-10% of revenue now (JLR EV platforms) fading to 8%: luxury cars stay capital-hungry.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: JLR hits its c.4% FY27 EBIT guidance and the new Range Rovers and Jaguar take EBIT back towards 8% by FY29; China stabilises and the Stellantis deal eases US tariffs. India keeps 20%+ volume growth and PLI-free margins reach 8%.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: JLR misses guidance: EBIT stays ~2-3% as China worsens, VME stays high and EV launches slip or cannibalise; India commodity inflation persists and competition in EVs cuts margins to ~4-5%.
